name: Detail Agent Set
description: Creates a detail set: one way to build a panel feature (opening, MEP penetration, niche, linear service). The built-in sets are examples and the stud panel defaults, not the only options. Right-click to choose the set; its parameters appear as inputs. Connect it to a feature component's 'detail_set' to build those features with it, or to a populator's 'default_detail_sets' to build every feature of the types it supports.
